# fjordrun_agent (Resource)

An AI agent of a team. `fjordrun_models` lists the models. Chatting with an agent is a one-off action of the API and the dashboard, not part of this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "fjordrun_agent" "support" {
  team_id       = var.team_id
  name          = "support"
  description   = "Answers support questions"
  model         = "claude-haiku-5-5"
  system_prompt = "You answer questions about our shop. Be brief."
  tools         = ["web_fetch", "kv_memory"]
  max_steps     = 5
  temperature   = 0.3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name (1-100 characters).
- `team_id` (String) Team ID.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free text (up to 2000 characters).
- `max_steps` (Number) Most steps per run (1-100, default 10).
- `model` (String) Model ID (see `fjordrun_models`). The API picks its default if left out.
- `project_id` (String) Attach the agent to a project of the team.
- `system_prompt` (String) System prompt (up to 100000 characters).
- `temperature` (Number) Model temperature (0-1, default 1).
- `tools` (Set of String) Tools the agent may use: `http_request`, `run_code`, `web_fetch`, `kv_memory` and `invoke_service`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `id` (String) Agent ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# by agent ID
terraform import fjordrun_agent.support dddddddd-dddd-dddd-dddd-dddddddddddd
```
